raw_text:
name: dotnet-upgrade
description: .NET upgrade analysis/execution prompts.
Analyze all solution projects: classify `.NET Framework`, `.NET Core`, `.NET Standard`; inspect each `.csproj` `TargetFramework`/SDK. Review dependency compatibility/graph depth, legacy `packages.config`→`PackageReference`, transitive conflicts, shared dependencies, outdated NuGet packages and .NET 8 support. Plan least→most dependent ordering, incremental rollback checkpoints, Upgrade Assistant/manual upgrades, targets (e.g. `net8.0`), deprecated SDK/build configs, modernization, async conversion, API replacements (`Startup.cs`→`Program.cs`), and deprecated APIs via `.NET Upgrade Assistant`/API Analyzer. Analyze YAML SDK pinning; update `UseDotNet@2`, `NuGetToolInstaller`; generate .NET 8 pipelines, CI automation, validation builds, tests, telemetry/connectivity, UAT/production checks. Recommend branching/PR/review/documentation/stakeholder/dashboard strategies, release notes, artifacts, multi-repo validation. Use `.NET Upgrade Assistant`, `dotnet list package --outdated`, `dotnet migrate`, `graph.json`; generate analysis scripts/prompts and final completion checklist.
